1661-2079-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4247-4772-5254.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
4247-4772-5254.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

1829-1981-2415-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat.
1829-1981-2415-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1479-5233-5362.description:
Create a nonlegendary copy of Kodama of the East Tree using Quantum Misalignment (this may involve additional steps depending on the card used).
Play Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison enters, both Kodama of the East Trees and Boros Garrison trigger.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the legendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Boros Garrison onto the battlefield.
The nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree and Boros Garrison trigger.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree's trigger, putting Boros Garrison onto the battlefield.
The legendary Kodama of the East Tree and Boros Garrison trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

341-3375-4200-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1619-2292-4605-5542-6151.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2292-4605-5542-6151.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Underdark Explorer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Underdark Explorer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Underdark Explorer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Underdark Explorer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Underdark Explorer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Underdark Explorer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Underdark Explorer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Underdark Explorer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2292-4605-5542-6151.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

3532-5078-6604-7692.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Clinquant Skymage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

997-2180-6972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Nearheath Stalker
When Nearheath Stalker dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Nearheath Stalker
When Nearheath Stalker dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Nearheath Stalker enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
997-2180-6972.notes: If Nearheath Stalker starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

2173-5220-6826-7452.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
2173-5220-6826-7452.description:
Activate Masked Meower by discarding a card and sacrificing it.
When Masked Meower dies, Mortuary and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Masked Meower from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Masked Meower ability.
Cast Masked Meower from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

3197-4120-5686-7352.notablePrerequisites: Vigor has indestructible, protection from creatures or protection from red.
3197-4120-5686-7352.description:
Cast Electric Seaweed by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Electric Seaweed enters, it triggers.
Activate Electric Seaweed by tapping it, attempting to deal 1 damage to Herd Baloth, which will instead put a +1/+1 counter on it due to Vigor.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Electric Seaweed triggers, dealing 1 damage to each non-Wall creature your opponents control. Each non-Wall creature you control (excluding Vigor) will not be dealt damage, and will instead have a +1/+1 counter put on it due to Vigor.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 5.

2308-4050-4871-5870.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
2308-4050-4871-5870.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters, Guide of Souls triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {R}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Guide of Souls trigger, causing you to gain life and get {E}
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2781-3817.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Sister Hospitaller
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

874-4195-4574-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
874-4195-4574-6650.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-4195-4574-6650.description:
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Delif's Cone from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Delif's Cone from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

856-5220-5231-6900.manaNeeded: {B} if Cauldron Familiar is in your hand
856-5220-5231-6900.easyPrerequisites: You have a life total of at least 2 if Cauldron Familiar is on top of your library.
856-5220-5231-6900.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {B} or 1 life respectively.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

339-677-2292-4068.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
339-677-2292-4068.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

890-1247-5536.notablePrerequisites:
Rex does not have summoning sickness.
Palladium Myr and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.
890-1247-5536.description:
Activate Rex using Palladium Myr's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

423-765-3609-4011.notablePrerequisites:
Magistrate's Scepter has at least one charge counter on it.
You are able to play a number of lands this turn equal to four minus the number of charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
423-765-3609-4011.description:
Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Evolution Sage trigger.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Repeat from step 1 until Magistrate's Scepter has four or more charge counters on it.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1734-3175-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Fiend Hunter, adding {R}.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sun Titan to the battlefield from exile.
When Sun Titan enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Repeat.

813-1777-3085.description:
Cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing Scholar of the Ages, adding seven mana in any combination of {B} and/or {R}.
Cast Zombify by paying {3}{B}, returning Scholar of the Ages from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Scholar of the Ages triggers, returning Burnt Offering and Zombify from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

225-757-4235.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-757-4235.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by tapping it and paying {U}.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers; choose not to pay for it.
Resolve the Magosi ability, putting an eon counter on Magosi and skipping your next turn.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it targeting Magosi.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers; choose not to pay for it.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers; pay {2} and copy the Magosi ability.
Resolve both copies of the ability, cancelling out your skipped turn and taking an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat each turn.

Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Stadium Vendors and Mnemonic Wall, blinking them.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Stadium Vendors enters the battlefield, add {U}{U}.
